Messages.Author: Bern
Messages.Body:
1. What happens if a tremere, taking a leave torpor action, is blocked, and
a slave gargoyle wants to do the combat? Does the blocking minion get
oppurtunity to diablirize?

2. If Rock-Cat plays torn signpost, does it get 2, 3 or 4 strength?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Bern wrote:
> 1. What happens if a tremere, taking a leave torpor action, is blocked, and
> a slave gargoyle wants to do the combat? Does the blocking minion get
> oppurtunity to diablirize?

No.

> 2. If Rock-Cat plays torn signpost, does it get 2, 3 or 4 strength?

2. Torn Signpost sets strength. Rock Cat has no bonuses to strength,
so the value set is all there is.
